baselinePresentation.finding: The iOS 27 simulator opened the old rectangle-anchored presenter. UIKit’s SDK header describes that overload for iPad and the unanchored presenter for iPhone.

iOS27.checks: The documented iPhone presenter opened native Print Options. Cancel returned to the large-print list. Relaunch preserved milk before apples, the original private note and the checked soap in history.

pdfExport.visualChecks: Read the complete rendered page. The title, item names and quantities are aligned and legible. Milk precedes apples, and neither the private note nor checked soap appears.

iOS17.earlierFinding: The first run passed all models and stopped before printing. XCTest exposed the visible list options Menu with a nested button and no computed hit point. The rerun taps the control’s center.

scope: Simulator print preview, PDF export, local list state and supported iPhone presenter. Physical AirPrint remains a device acceptance check.

initialHarness.finding: Before the print action, XCTest found the saved note in the app accessibility hierarchy with the large-print sheet open. The successful checks inspect the actual system-rendered page and the saved ledger separately.
